family_name: E-Therm Reflective Roof and Wall Insulation

spec.description:
Thermotec E-Therm is a
high-performance, Australian-made double-sided reflective foam roof, wall, and
underfloor insulation engineered to replace traditional bulk insulation and
sarking. Formulated with a closed-cell low-density polyethylene (LDPE) foam core
laminated on both sides with pure aluminum foil facings (one side featuring a
green anti-glare coating), it delivers an in-situ thermal break of up to R0.25
to prevent thermal bridging on steel-framed buildings. It incorporates a
patented 150mm foil overlap flap, effectively manages condensation, and reduces
acoustic rain and airborne noise by up to 12 dB.
features:
3-in-1
solution: thermal insulation, R0.20+ thermal break, and vapor barrier in one
product

Pure aluminum reflective foil facings reflect up to 97% of radiant
heat (emittance 0.03)

Available in 5mm (R0.16), 6.5mm (R0.20), and 8mm
(R0.25) closed-cell foam core thicknesses

Patented 150mm foil overlap flap
eliminates the cost of purchasing extra product for laps

Reduces radiated
rain, aircraft, and traffic noise by up to 12 dB

Completely waterproof
closed-cell polyethylene foam will not rot, shrink, or sag over time

Anti-glare green coating on one face ensures safe daytime installation on
roofs

Zero fibers, non-allergenic, non-toxic, and itch-free handling without
PPE
Manufactured in Australia incorporating up to 80% recycled foam content
GreenStar and BASIX compliant meeting international ODP-EMI9 requirements

AS/NZS 4859.1:2002/Amdt 1, AS 1530.2, AS 3959, NCC BCA Volume One
and Two (R0.20 thermal break compliant)
install:
Roll out E-Therm over roof
purlins, rafters, or wall framing with anti-glare green face facing outward
toward the installer

Allow a nominal 40mm drape between purlins on roofs to
create an airspace and facilitate condensation drainage

Align adjacent rolls
using the patented 150mm factory foil overlap flap

Tape all longitudinal and
transverse seams using 48mm or 72mm reinforced aluminium foil tape to form a
continuous seal

Fasten metal roof sheets or wall cladding directly through
the E-Therm into steel or timber framing

Ensure E-Therm terminates cleanly at
the gutter line to drain condensation into gutters

For steel framed walls,
use E-Therm 65 or 80 to satisfy the mandatory R0.20 in-situ thermal break
requirement

For suspended timber floors, fix beneath floor joists maintaining
a 20mm still air cavity
selection_checklist:
Confirm building type
(residential home, steel shed, commercial warehouse, or underfloor)

Select
thickness (6.5mm E-Therm 65 for R0.20 thermal break on steel framing; 8mm for
higher R0.25 rating)

Calculate roll quantities based on 30 m² net coverage
per roll (patented 150mm flap eliminates overlap wastage)

Order matching 72mm
reinforced aluminium foil sealing tape

Verify minimum 20mm airspace is
maintained in roof and wall cavities to achieve rated system R-values
accessories: Thermotec Ezy Tear Reinforced Aluminium Foil Tape (72mm)
Thermotec MaxTape FR / Insulating Foam Tape
limitations:
Requires an adjacent sealed airspace of at least 20mm to
generate rated total system R-values

Avoid direct contact with wet alkaline
concrete or mortar to prevent aluminum foil etching

Not designed as a
trafficable roof membrane; do not walk directly on unsupported insulation
spec.warranty: Backed by Thermotec Australia product warranty

problem_keywords: meeting NCC R0.2 thermal break code
use_cases:
Installing over steel roof purlins and
wall girts in residential homes and sheds to provide an NCC-compliant R0.20
thermal break

Condensation control and radiant heat reflection under
residential and commercial corrugated metal roofs

Underfloor thermal barrier
installed beneath suspended timber floor joists to block cold winter draughts
Acoustic rain noise reduction in metal-clad industrial buildings and garages
not_for:
Cold climate wall assemblies requiring Class 4 vapour-permeable
breathable wraps
Direct floor traffic surfaces without subflooring
retrieval.rag_summary:
Thermotec
E-Therm is an Australian-made 3-in-1 reflective insulation, thermal break, and
vapor barrier manufactured from closed-cell low-density polyethylene foam faced
with pure aluminum foil on both sides (with an anti-glare green coating on one
face). Available in 5mm (R0.16), 6.5mm (R0.20), and 8mm (R0.25) thicknesses
in 1350mm x 22.25m rolls (30 m²) with a patented 150mm overlap flap, it provides
the mandatory R0.20 in-situ thermal break on steel frames while reflecting up
to 97% of radiant heat and dampening rain noise by up to 12 dB. Tested to
AS 1530.2 (Flammability Index ≤ 5, BAL-40 compliant) and containing up to 80%
recycled foam content, it delivers complete thermal and condensation control.
